scheme_name: Sathya Ammaiyar Ninaivu Government Children Homes
other_conditions: Destitute, deserted and abandoned children are eligible
Children without parents or with a single parent are eligible
Children of ailing parents, prisoners, or where parents are unable to care for them due to severe disability are eligible
Boys are eligible up to the 5th Standard
Girl children must be between 5 and 18 years old; if they are without father and mother, they may be admitted up to 21 years for higher studies
benefits_summary: Provides free food, accommodation, education, uniforms, textbooks, medical care, chappals and bedding to eligible children.
